ev.quote: # The Impact of Inference Acceleration on Bias of LLMs

contribution.value: Probes how five inference acceleration strategies (INT4/INT8, AWQ, KV4/KV8, structured/unstructured Wanda pruning) change demographic bias in three instruction-tuned LLMs across six bias metrics.

ev.quote: Our assessment includes five commonly used inference acceleration techniques and three widely used LLMs. Noting the multidimensional nature of bias
CrowSPairs (Nangia et al., 2020) is a dataset of crowd-sourced sentence pairs designed to evaluate stereotypes related to race, gender
GlobalOpinionQA (Durmus et al., 2024) uses multiple-choice questions to assess the opinions stated by a model relative to aggregated population opinions from different countries
WorldBench (Moayeri et al., 2024) evaluates performance disparities in an LLM's ability to recall facts (e.g., population, GDP, and capital) about different countries
DT-Stereotyping. DecodingTrust (Wang et al., 2024) is a framework for evaluating the trustworthiness of LLMs across eight dimensions, one of which is stereotype bias
DiscrimEval (Tamkin et al., 2023) consists of 70 hypothetical decision making scenarios, e.g., approving a loan
we propose a new dataset DiscrimEvalGen. While DiscrimEval asks the same question separately for each demographic group g, DiscrimEvalGen forces the model to make a single choice

strengths.value: Tests six diverse bias metrics across three modern instruction-tuned LLMs and five acceleration strategies

ev.quote: Our assessment includes five commonly used inference acceleration techniques and three widely used LLMs ... we test the models with six different bias metrics

strengths.value: Introduces a new generation-based bias dataset, DiscrimEvalGen, that forces the model to choose between groups

ev.quote: we propose a new dataset DiscrimEvalGen. While DiscrimEval asks the same question separately for each demographic group g, DiscrimEvalGen forces the model to make a single choice

strengths.value: Releases full code on GitHub for reproducibility of every metric and acceleration setting

ev.quote: The code for our experiments is available at https://github.com/aisoc-lab/inference-acceleration-bias

strengths.value: Shows that bias effects after quantization are model-specific and direction-unpredictable, contradicting prior uniform claims

ev.quote: Worryingly, these bias effects are complex and unpredictable. A combination of an acceleration strategy and bias type may show little bias change in one model but may lead to a large effect in another

weaknesses.value: Benchmark coverage is not exhaustive and may miss domain-specific or harder bias manifestations

ev.quote: the set of benchmarks used in our evaluation and their coverage of different domains and demographic groups is not exhaustive

weaknesses.value: Only training-free acceleration is studied; fine-tuning and retraining-based methods are excluded

ev.quote: we focused only on training-free acceleration strategies. While these strategies are practical and widely used, this excludes other methods, such as fine-tuning or retraining

weaknesses.value: Fixed hyperparameters (greedy and five-sample nucleus) limit the range of behaviors observed

ev.quote: our use of fixed hyperparameters (e.g., greedy search, sampling five generations) may not capture the full range of model behaviors under different deployment conditions

weaknesses.value: Results should be read as indicative, not definitive, since bias in modern instruction-tuned LLMs is under-explored

ev.quote: our results should be taken as indicative rather than definitive since bias in modern, instruction-tuned LLMs remains an under-explored area

limitations.value: Only three 7B-8B models are evaluated; results may not transfer to larger or non-chat variants

ev.quote: We consider the smallest size variant of each model: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-3.1- 8B, and Mistral-7B-v0.3

limitations.value: DiscrimEvalGen is restricted to gender groups only, dropping race and age intersectionality

ev.quote: we limit the groups to those based on gender, that is, G = {man, non-binary, woman}

limitations.value: KV cache quantization is not implemented for Mistral, leaving holes in the comparison grid

ev.quote: We use the native HuggingFace implementation. This implementation does not support Mistral models

limitations.value: Demographic bias is the only safety axis studied; toxicity, jailbreak, and refusal direction are not measured

ev.quote: Our analysis focused on demographic bias. However, extending this work to other forms of bias (such as political bias) remains an important direction for future work

future_work_stated.value: Incorporate inference acceleration into model alignment training to proactively address bias

ev.quote: Incorporating these strategies into the model alignment process can help proactively address biases

ev.quote: explore approaches that integrate explicit bias mitigation objectives, such as fairness-aware training methods or bias-sensitive hyperparameter optimization

future_work_stated.value: Study hybrid approaches that mix pruning with quantization

ev.quote: exploring the combined effects of multiple strategies, such as hybrid approaches that mix pruning with quantization, could provide valuable insights
